Q5217.reason: Under UCC 2-207 the confirmation was expressly conditional on the loading charge, so it is a counteroffer, and with no acceptance or performance there is no contract.

Q8260.reason: Water is made directly by reducing oxygen at the end of the electron transport chain, so it stops first; glycolysis and pyruvate continue without oxygen.

Q5585.reason: A lay witness may give an estimated speed opinion if shown adequate opportunity to observe and the experience to estimate vehicle speed, so the objection should be overruled on that foundation.
